body:
### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug?

platform-server

### Is this a regression?

No

### Description

# ngModule version
I clone the Angular Universal repo version from angular:

- checkout master then: `pnpm install`
- `pnpm dev:ssr` to serve
- `nodemon --inspect=localhost:9236 dist/server/main.js` to inspect

Then I start it and make a heap snapshot. it's fine.
Open dev tools for Node.js to inspect, Go to memory tab, search `module` keyword
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175274730-f916ae29-6844-4fb8-80bd-31d3163f0d65.png)

first-time load home page:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175272300-fb9306f2-1c90-42ec-a7d9-729302bc6772.png)
load home page at second time:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175272485-6b60981c-b889-4b8f-9179-3e99ef2a37ef.png)

load home page at 20th times:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175272463-3c3d8131-c363-48bf-901e-4e861569b972.png)

everything is fine and no leak. NgModule only have 2 instance

# Standalone version

I upgrade the universal version of the standalone component, I'm going to make this on the universal repo, but first, it has a memory leak.

- checkout master then: `pnpm install`
- `pnpm dev:ssr` to serve
- `nodemon --inspect=localhost:9236 dist/server/main.js` to inspect

go home page and f5 for 6 times:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175273653-42ad493b-93df-4216-8d60-0b0910fcceff.png)

go home page and f5 for more 5 times:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16970990/175273755-f871720a-ab46-4c2a-91b7-867dee1bb9df.png)

we get too many modules that are not clear and the heap memory goes "To infinity and beyond".
The ApplicationModule goes to x6 on 6 load pages, and x11 if you have 11 load pages.


### Please provide a link to a minimal reproduction of the bug

https://github.com/hiepxanh/universal-test

### Please provide the exception or error you saw

_No response_

### Please provide the environment you discovered this bug in (run `ng version`)

```true
Angular CLI: 14.0.2
Node: 16.13.1
Package Manager: pnpm 7.1.5
OS: win32 x64

Angular: 14.0.3
... animations, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, forms
... platform-browser, platform-browser-dynamic, platform-server
... router

Package                         Version
---------------------------------------------------------
@angular-devkit/architect       0.1400.2
@angular-devkit/build-angular   14.0.2
@angular-devkit/core            14.0.2
@angular-devkit/schematics      14.0.2
@angular/cli                    14.0.2
@nguniversal/builders           14.0.1
@nguniversal/common             14.0.1
@nguniversal/express-engine     14.0.1
@schematics/angular             14.0.2
rxjs                            7.5.5
typescript                      4.7.4
```


### Anything else?

I'm running the standalone SSR version in my production version. Current work around is restart the server :D
